dossierSnapshot: CivicState has real app code but remains Watchlist until paid demand and deliverability are proven.
adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

authority.reason: Only operator merge upgrades authority; this worker cannot claim adopted status.

methods: Read existing planning and implementation files.
Separated repo-supported evidence from unsupported external market assumptions.
Modeled financial scenarios from repo pricing tiers and stated cost assumptions.
Preserved contradictory source signals in Surprise Spikes rather than smoothing them.

honestyLabels.evidenceDefinition: A claim directly supported by repository, planning, code, tests, or dispatch text.
honestyLabels.assumptionDefinition: A claim inferred from model reasoning, external category knowledge, or arithmetic using repo inputs.
honestyLabels.externalClaims: All external market claims are marked as assumptions because network research was unavailable.

thesis.current: CivicState can become a paid civic-action workflow if users pay for researched, citation-backed letters and officials reliably receive them.

real: Prisma schema covers users, submissions, campaigns, letters, officials, payments, deliveries, ledger, audit, agent logs, and jobs.
Worker agents for classifier, researcher, drafter, delivery, treasury, and reconciliation exist.
Tests exist for multiple product surfaces.
notProven: Operator intent to pitch as a business

marketSizing.method: bottom-up scenario model from repo price tiers because no network research was available

beachhead.honesty: assumption: arithmetic from repo tiers; demand not validated

singleDropletCeiling.honesty: assumption: arithmetic from repo tiers; 5000/mo capacity referenced in MASTER_PLAN.md

tamProxy.honesty: assumption: external population/incidence proxy, not network-verified

customers.primary: United States resident with a concrete civic issue who wants help researching, drafting, and routing official communications.
customers.future: HOAs, nonprofits, and civic organizations after consumer validation.
customers.excluded: Legal-advice seekers, claim filers, regulatory submitters, harassment/threat actors, and bulk-abuse campaigns.

competition.honesty: assumption: category role not network-verified; name appears in repo planning

risksAntiplan.skepticView: Do not fund this as a venture-scale company until paid demand, official deliverability, and legal/compliance boundaries are proven.
killConditions: Paid conversion below 3% by validation review.
Moderation queue routinely older than 24 hours.
Operator confirms this should remain a personal/research asset.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Run concierge beta with real payments.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Users may like previews but refuse to pay.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Warm domain, monitor bounces, track inbox placement, and pause risky domains.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Officials may suppress generated mail regardless of technical setup.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: Official data coverage may be incomplete.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Measure federal, state, and local lookup success by ZIP and provider.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Local data may require expensive or restricted providers.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: Legal and abuse boundaries are sensitive.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Human audit, legal review, moderation, opt-outs, disclaimers, and retention policies.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: One bad generated letter can create reputational or legal exposure.

assumptionLedger.assumption: Users will pay $5-$25 for civic-letter packages.
Email-only delivery is sufficient at launch.
SEO can become a repeatable acquisition channel.
assumptionLedger.validation: Indexed public campaign pages and search traffic.
Queue age and support minutes per job.

goToMarket.initial: Concierge paid beta before SEO scale.
goToMarket.repoHypothesis: Organic search from opt-in public campaign pages; social sharing secondary; no paid ads at launch.

roadmap.shape: validation queue with 8 single-worker checkbox items
roadmap.priority: prove demand, delivery, coverage, citation quality, and legal/compliance readiness
